integrity.mathematical_evidence: Exhaustive 28-orbit reduction, rational ranks, two-prime modular cross-check of all 1081 normalized triples
integrity.novelty_claim: Exact mixed-coset nullity classification and complete order-signature census, not the known general Cayley block decomposition.

scientific_limitations: Unweighted convolution by exactly three distinct support elements on the order-48 binary octahedral group only.
Does not classify weighted supports, supports with a different cardinality, or nonzero eigenvalues.
Reproducible exact finite enumeration rather than a symbolic all-group classification; independently auditing the program and mathematical argument remains open.
Possibility of an unlocated preexisting equivalent table remains.
title: Complete three-tap convolution nullities on the binary octahedral group
